headline: Japan releases a terms-gated 5,025-hour HSR mobile-manipulation dataset
summary: Japan’s GENIAC program and the AI Robot Association released the AIRoA MoMa 5k real-robot mobile-manipulation dataset with a continued-pretraining model and training code. The dataset card reports 1,184,259 successful episodes and 5,025.1 hours from 44 HSR robots at five sites, but access is terms-gated, limited to research and development, train-only and success-only. The program page separately reports a 3-point task-success gain without a task denominator or matched evaluation details.
